name: @openflowkit/openflowkit-mcp
description: Local-first Model Context Protocol server for OpenFlowKit — pair the live editor or edit .openflow.json files: create/update/read diagrams from DSL, scene ops, icon search, export. No account, no cloud.

scripts.prebuild: npm run build:icons && npm run build:grammar && npm run build:agent && npm run build:map-viewer
scripts.dev:remote: npm run build:icons && npm run build:grammar && npm run build:agent && npx -y wrangler@4.149.0 dev
scripts.deploy:remote: npm run build:icons && npm run build:grammar && npm run build:agent && npx -y wrangler@4.149.0 deploy
scripts.pretest: npm run build:icons && npm run build:agent && node scripts/ensure-map-viewer.mjs
scripts.pretest:run: npm run build:icons && npm run build:agent && node scripts/ensure-map-viewer.mjs
scripts.eval:agent: npm run build:agent && vitest --config vitest.config.ts --run evals
scripts.eval:validity: npm run build:icons && npm run build:agent && tsx evals/validity/run.ts
